new_nodes.detail: Mass sensing picks a defrost program and ends it at a safe temperature without any choice from the user.

ideas.title: Knob-Free Fully Sealed Oven

new_nodes.label: Sealed capacitive panel
new_nodes.detail: A flat glass panel with capacitive touch and no moving parts; the oven is wiped clean and has no mechanical wear.

ideas.rationale: A flat, sealed panel with one touch per function is impossible to misuse.

ideas.title: Pictogram Dial

new_nodes.label: Four-picture food dial
new_nodes.detail: One dial with pictures: frozen, leftovers, drink, snack. Each picture sets time and power automatically.

new_nodes.detail: Maps a visual food category to a preset time and power.

ideas.rationale: Users choose by recognising a picture of their food, so no timer or power numbers need to be understood.

ideas.title: Weight-Sensing Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Load-cell tray sensor

ideas.title: Single-Mode Cooker

new_nodes.label: Adaptive pulsing without user setting
new_nodes.detail: Internal controller pulses power automatically from food feedback, so no power level is set.

ideas.rationale: With no power setting to choose, there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Glowing Ceramic Cavity Glaze

new_nodes.label: Electroluminescent ceramic glaze
new_nodes.detail: Phosphor-doped glaze inside the cavity lights up when the door opens, with no filament.

new_nodes.label: Luminous cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: Cavity wall that glows on its own.

ideas.rationale: The cavity is always visible with no bulb to burn out or find.

ideas.title: Nano-Mesh Transparent Door

new_nodes.label: Clear microwave-tight door pane
new_nodes.detail: Full-glass door with a nano-mesh film instead of perforated metal.

ideas.rationale: A clear door lets anyone see the food at a glance, with no hunting for a window or a light.

new_nodes.label: Sliding door panel
new_nodes.detail: Replaces hinged door and latch.

ideas.title: Antenna Mode-Stirrer

ideas.title: Solid-State GaN Amplifier

new_nodes.detail: Replaces magnetron and HV chain.

ideas.rationale: Without a lethal HV supply or an ageing magnetron, the appliance can be left alone safely for years.

ideas.title: Switching PSU Replaces HV Transformer

new_nodes.label: High-frequency switching power supply
new_nodes.detail: Small SMPS that replaces the bulky mains transformer.

ideas.rationale: Lower cost and less hum, so the appliance feels simpler and cheaper to buy.

ideas.title: Low-Voltage RF Stack

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage capacitive RF drive
new_nodes.detail: Drive with no stored high voltage, so nothing is left charged.

ideas.rationale: Removing the stored charge removes the fear of an unplugged appliance still being dangerous.

ideas.title: Wireless Induction Base

new_nodes.detail: Magnetic resonance coupling from a base to the cooking unit.

new_nodes.label: Cordless cooking puck
new_nodes.detail: Dish or cavity unit that draws power from a flat base.

ideas.rationale: Dropping the unit on a base means there is no plug, cord, or socket to figure out.

ideas.title: Single Big Button Fascia

new_nodes.label: One large start button
new_nodes.detail: A single oversized button that starts the default program.

ideas.rationale: One obvious button is the simplest possible interface for anyone.

ideas.title: NFC Food-Tag Cooking

new_nodes.label: NFC food packaging tag
new_nodes.detail: Tag on packaging carries time, power and cavity settings.

new_nodes.label: Reads cooking program from packaging
new_nodes.detail: Oven reads the tag when the food is placed on the tray.

ideas.rationale: The food package sets the oven, so the user never needs to know any settings.

ideas.title: Hourglass Liquid-Column Timer

new_nodes.label: Coloured fluid time column
new_nodes.detail: Column of coloured fluid that drains to show time left.

ideas.rationale: Time is shown as a level going down, which can be read at a glance without numbers.

ideas.title: Breathing Light Ring Silent Mode

new_nodes.label: Breathing light ring
new_nodes.detail: Soft pulsing light ring around the control area that signals end of cycle.

ideas.rationale: A visual signal works in a quiet house or for someone who cannot hear the bell.

ideas.title: Top-Loading Pull-Out Drawer

new_nodes.label: Pull-out cooking drawer
new_nodes.detail: Cavity slides out like a drawer; food is placed on a flat tray.

ideas.rationale: Pulling out a drawer is an action everyone already understands and needs no bending or reaching.

ideas.title: Polyfuse Self-Reset

new_nodes.label: Resettable polymer PTC fuse
new_nodes.detail: Polymer fuse that resets itself after a fault clears.

ideas.rationale: No one has to find and replace a blown fuse, so the appliance is simpler to recover.

ideas.title: Single Magnetic Reed Interlock

new_nodes.label: Magnetic reed door sensor
new_nodes.detail: One reed switch and magnet in the door frame replace the three switches.

ideas.rationale: A simpler door sensor reduces the parts needed and removes a confusing cluster of switches.

ideas.title: Fabric Swap-Cover Wrapper

new_nodes.label: Swappable fabric cover
new_nodes.detail: Soft zip-on cover in colours, replacing the steel wrapper.

ideas.rationale: A soft, familiar cover looks and feels friendly instead of technical.

ideas.title: Disposable Cavity Liner

new_nodes.label: Disposable microwave liner
new_nodes.detail: Paper-like liner that lines the cavity and is thrown away.

ideas.rationale: Spills land on a liner that is thrown away, so there is nothing to scrub.

ideas.title: Disposable Mica Film

new_nodes.label: Peel-off splatter film
new_nodes.detail: Thin peel-off film replaces the fixed mica sheet.

ideas.rationale: A dirty film is peeled off and replaced, so no one has to clean the waveguide cover.

ideas.title: Susceptor Crisp Plate

new_nodes.label: Microwave susceptor plate
new_nodes.detail: Metal-oxide coating heats up in the field and browns food from below.

new_nodes.label: Browning plate
new_nodes.detail: Flat plate that replaces the glass turntable.

ideas.rationale: One simple plate gives browning with no separate grill or setting to choose.

ideas.title: Token-Magnet Power Setting

new_nodes.label: Food-type magnet token
new_nodes.detail: Magnetic tile placed on the door sets power and time, replacing the knob.

ideas.rationale: Sticking a tile to the door is a physical act that cannot be done wrongly.

ideas.title: Passive Heat-Pipe Cooling

new_nodes.label: Heat pipe with fin array
new_nodes.detail: Sealed heat pipe moves heat from the magnetron to outside fins with no fan.

ideas.rationale: No fan noise or dust to think about, so the appliance is silent and self-managing.

ideas.title: Knock-to-Start

new_nodes.label: Vibration knock detector
new_nodes.detail: Accelerometer in the door reads a light tap as the start command.

ideas.rationale: Tapping the door is a gesture everyone understands, even without reading any labels.

ideas.title: Self-Resetting PTC Thermal Cutout

new_nodes.label: PTC thermistor overheat limiter
new_nodes.detail: Self-resetting thermistor replaces both thermal cutouts.

ideas.rationale: Overheating is handled automatically and resets itself, so no one needs to act on it.

ideas.title: Shielded Cord Replaces EMI Block

new_nodes.label: Shielded integral cord
new_nodes.detail: Mains cord with built-in ferrite shielding replaces the filter block.

ideas.rationale: Fewer separate parts means lower cost and no extra box to fit in the cabinet.

ideas.title: Direct Probe Launch

new_nodes.label: Coaxial probe antenna
new_nodes.detail: Short probe feeds RF straight into the cavity and removes the waveguide duct.

ideas.rationale: A short probe is cheaper and means no metal duct to align or clean.

ideas.title: Cookware-as-Cavity

new_nodes.label: Cookware that is the cavity
new_nodes.detail: The user's own dish becomes the microwave cavity, sealed by a lid.

ideas.rationale: Reusing one dish removes the need for a separate cavity and the footprint it needs.

ideas.title: Moulded Recycled Polymer Shell

new_nodes.label: Recycled polymer injection moulding
new_nodes.detail: Shell moulded in one piece from recycled polymer, no stamping or welding.

ideas.rationale: A one-piece shell is cheaper to build and wipes clean in one go.

ideas.title: Foam Bumper Wrapper

new_nodes.label: Soft foam bumper frame
new_nodes.detail: Padded frame around the cabinet that absorbs knocks and cushions a fall.

ideas.rationale: Soft edges make the appliance safe for children and anyone who is unsteady.

ideas.title: Camera Peek Cavity View

new_nodes.label: Cavity camera with auto-display
new_nodes.detail: Small camera shows the food on a built-in display when cooking.

ideas.rationale: The food is shown on a screen without opening the door or bending to look inside.

ideas.title: Air-Curtain Door Seal

new_nodes.label: Air curtain RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: Pressurised air gap replaces the quarter-wave choke seal.

ideas.rationale: Without a groove to clean around the door rim, cleaning is simpler.

ideas.title: Universal Auto-Range PSU

new_nodes.label: Universal voltage autoranging
new_nodes.detail: Power supply accepts 100 to 240 V at 50 or 60 Hz without a variant.

ideas.rationale: One model works everywhere, so the user never picks the wrong version.

ideas.title: Ceramic Glass Coating Wall

new_nodes.label: Smooth ceramic glass cavity coating
new_nodes.detail: Glassy coating that resists stains and wipes clean.

ideas.rationale: Spills wipe off in one stroke, which is simpler than scrubbing enamel.

ideas.title: Silicone Flexible Turntable

new_nodes.label: Unbreakable silicone plate
new_nodes.detail: Flexible silicone plate that replaces the glass tray.

ideas.rationale: A plate that cannot shatter is safer for families and easier to handle.

ideas.title: Aroma Done Signal

new_nodes.label: Aroma release cartridge
new_nodes.detail: Small cartridge releases a food-like scent when cooking ends.

ideas.rationale: A smell tells the user the food is ready without any need to read or listen.

ideas.title: Piezo Silent Fan

new_nodes.label: Piezoelectric fan
new_nodes.detail: Vibrating piezo element moves air silently with no motor or bearings.

ideas.rationale: No motor means no noise to worry about and no moving parts to wear out.

ideas.title: Light-Ring Power Indicator

new_nodes.label: Colour-ring power indicator
new_nodes.detail: Ring of light on the tray edge shows power as colour: green is gentle, red is full.

ideas.rationale: Colour replaces numbers, so the power level is obvious without any learning.

ideas.title: Current-Limit GaN Driver

new_nodes.label: Digital current limiter
new_nodes.detail: Electronic limit replaces the ceramic fuse and thermal cutout with one chip.

ideas.rationale: One chip protects the appliance with no fuse to replace and no separate cutout to test.

ideas.title: Radar Food Scan

new_nodes.detail: Low-power radar reads food state and sets cooking automatically.

ideas.rationale: The machine senses when food is ready, so the user only places it and presses nothing.

ideas.title: Pictogram Dial

new_nodes.label: Food-icon dial
new_nodes.detail: Single dial with raised icons for popcorn, leftovers, frozen meal and drink, replacing numbered minutes.

ideas.rationale: Users pick a food picture instead of guessing minutes, so there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Weighing Turntable

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable
new_nodes.detail: Strain gauges under the turntable estimate mass and set cook time automatically.

ideas.rationale: The machine sets its own time from what is placed on it, so the user never touches a timer.

ideas.title: One-Press Cook

new_nodes.label: Single cook button
new_nodes.detail: One large button that starts the cycle using a preset based on load and food sensing.

ideas.rationale: A single press replaces two knobs, so the entire operating procedure is one obvious action.

ideas.title: Close-to-Start Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic auto-start latch
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door until the magnet clicks engages the magnetron without any button.

ideas.rationale: Closing the door is the only action needed, which matches what people already do with any cupboard.

ideas.title: Push-Anywhere Door

new_nodes.detail: Pressing any part of the door face releases the latch, so there is no small button to find.

ideas.title: Hand-Wave Release

new_nodes.label: Infrared proximity opener
new_nodes.detail: A hand held near the handle triggers the latch release.

ideas.rationale: Reaching toward the door is an intuitive gesture, so no press has to be learned.

ideas.title: Tap-Twice Knock Opening

new_nodes.label: Knock-sensing accelerometer
new_nodes.detail: A door accelerometer recognises two taps on the glass and releases the latch.

ideas.rationale: Knocking on a door is a universal gesture that requires no instruction.

ideas.title: Shape-Memory Latch

new_nodes.detail: A nitinol wire releases the hook when a small current passes through it, removing the spring lever.

ideas.rationale: Fewer moving parts means fewer ways for the door to jam or confuse the user.

ideas.title: Sliding Pocket Door

new_nodes.label: Side-sliding door
new_nodes.detail: The door slides sideways into the wall of the casing, so no hinge or swing arc is needed.

ideas.rationale: A sliding door behaves like a cabinet or fridge door that people already understand.

ideas.title: Drop-Down Drawer

new_nodes.detail: The whole cavity slides out like a toaster drawer to load food, then slides back in to cook.

ideas.rationale: Loading food in a drawer is simpler than reaching into an opening, which helps users with limited reach.

ideas.title: Top-Lift Lid

ideas.title: Camera Preview Screen

ideas.rationale: A large display showing the food makes the state of cooking obvious without any training.

ideas.title: Light-Pipe Interior

new_nodes.detail: A light pipe carries LED light from outside the cavity to the inside, with no bulb or heat source inside.

ideas.rationale: The cavity stays lit with no hot element to avoid, so the interior is safer to look into.

ideas.title: Glowing Cavity Wall

new_nodes.label: Phosphor-coated cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: The cavity wall is coated with a phosphor that glows after a flash of light from the front LED.

ideas.rationale: The inside stays visible without an extra lamp, so there are fewer parts to fail.

ideas.title: Done Chime Turntable

ideas.rationale: A moving turntable is a visible and silent signal that does not depend on hearing.

ideas.title: Haptic Done Pulse

new_nodes.detail: A small vibration in the handle signals the end of cooking.

ideas.rationale: Users with hearing loss still get a clear end-of-cook signal they can feel in their hand.

ideas.title: Ring Countdown

new_nodes.detail: A ring of LEDs around the cook button shrinks as time runs out.

ideas.rationale: Time is shown as a shrinking shape, which can be read at a glance by anyone.

ideas.title: Scent Done Signal

new_nodes.detail: A small cartridge releases a food-like aroma when cooking is done.

ideas.rationale: Smell tells the user the food is ready even when they are in another room.

ideas.title: Auto-Open at Finish

new_nodes.label: Auto-release door
new_nodes.detail: The door unlatches and opens a few centimetres when cooking finishes.

ideas.rationale: The user does not need to remember to open the door, so food is never left inside.

ideas.title: Dish-Tagged Power

new_nodes.detail: A chip in the dish or meal tray sets the power level when placed inside.

ideas.rationale: The power is set by the food, so the user never chooses a power level at all.

ideas.title: Packet Barcode Cooking

new_nodes.label: Package code reader
new_nodes.detail: A scanner in the door reads a code printed on the food packet and sets power and time.

ideas.rationale: Scanning the packet is the same action people use at a supermarket checkout.

ideas.title: Sticker-Start Cooking

new_nodes.label: NFC food sticker
new_nodes.detail: Tapping a sticker on the packaging against the door sets time and power together.

ideas.rationale: Tapping a sticker is one action, and it needs no reading or number entry.

ideas.title: Single Tilt Dial

new_nodes.detail: A single lever tilted further means more heat and more time, like a thermostat.

ideas.rationale: One lever controls both time and heat, so the controls become a single intuitive movement.

ideas.title: Three Food Presets

new_nodes.detail: Three large buttons labelled Drink, Reheat and Cook, each with a fixed time and power.

ideas.title: Tactile Shape Knobs

ideas.title: Preset Heat Ramp

ideas.title: Sear-Melt-Warm Modes

new_nodes.label: Mode picker
new_nodes.detail: Three modes named Warm, Melt and Sear replace the five numbered power levels.

ideas.title: Glowing Power Bar

new_nodes.label: Heat intensity bar
new_nodes.detail: A horizontal bar of light that fills more as the power rises, shown on the front panel.

ideas.rationale: A bar that fills with heat gives an obvious sense of power with no numbers to read.

ideas.title: Power-by-Colour Dial

new_nodes.label: Colour ring dial
new_nodes.detail: Power is shown by a colour ring that moves from blue for gentle to red for strong.

ideas.rationale: Colour meanings such as blue and red are understood by almost everyone without teaching.

ideas.title: Voice Says Popcorn

new_nodes.label: Offline voice command

ideas.rationale: Speaking the food name requires no buttons, labels or reading.

ideas.title: Open-Loop Off Switch

ideas.rationale: The machine decides when to stop, so the user does not need to set or check a time.

ideas.title: Weight Scale Stop

ideas.rationale: Stopping on the right weight means the user never needs to judge how long to cook.

ideas.title: Cheap Coin Timer

ideas.rationale: A single chip is cheap to build and easy to set up on one large screen.

ideas.title: Universal Power Brick

new_nodes.label: Auto-voltage input
new_nodes.detail: A wide-range input supply accepts 100 to 240 V at 50 or 60 Hz, so one model works everywhere.

ideas.rationale: One model for every mains supply means users never need to check which version they have.

ideas.title: Wireless Base Power

ideas.rationale: Setting the appliance on a base with no cable to connect is a simple and quick setup.

ideas.title: Snap-Fit Shell

new_nodes.label: Injection-moulded snap shell
new_nodes.detail: A moulded polymer shell with snap-fit joints replaces stamped and welded steel panels.

ideas.rationale: Snap joints mean the casing is cheap to make and easy to keep in shape.

ideas.title: Paper-Pulp Cavity

new_nodes.label: Moulded fibre cavity

ideas.rationale: A recyclable fibre cavity is light, cheap and easy to replace if damaged.

ideas.title: Silicone Ring Tray

new_nodes.label: Silicone turntable ring
new_nodes.detail: A flexible silicone ring replaces the glass turntable and cannot shatter.

ideas.rationale: A flexible tray cannot crack from a knock, which removes a common reason to call for help.

ideas.title: Stationary Multi-Feed

new_nodes.label: Multi-feed waveguide
new_nodes.detail: Several waveguide feeds heat the cavity evenly, so the turntable is not needed.

ideas.rationale: Even heating without a moving part means there is nothing to misplace or stop turning.

ideas.title: Icon Labelled Door

new_nodes.label: Door icon guide
new_nodes.detail: A large printed icon on the door shows how to open, close and start the oven.

ideas.rationale: Picture-only instructions on the door are readable at a glance and need no manual.

ideas.title: Self-Cleaning Cavity

new_nodes.label: Non-stick cavity coating
new_nodes.detail: A cavity coating that food cannot stick to, so there is no need to wipe it clean.

ideas.rationale: Nothing needs cleaning or scrubbing, which removes a confusing maintenance task.

ideas.title: Fold-Flat Oven

new_nodes.label: Foldable shell
new_nodes.detail: The microwave folds flat for storage and unfolds into place without tools.

ideas.rationale: A unit that folds flat is easy to store and set up without needing help.

ideas.title: Tap-Table Oven

new_nodes.detail: The whole top surface is a single touch area that opens the door and starts cooking.

ideas.rationale: Touching anywhere on the top surface does the job, so there are no small controls to misplace.

ideas.title: Auto Door Cooking Start

ideas.rationale: Loading and closing the door is the only step, so starting happens on its own.

ideas.title: Hands-Free Mode

new_nodes.label: Gesture-free auto mode
new_nodes.detail: The oven picks time and power from a camera view of the food, with no controls used.

ideas.rationale: The machine chooses for the user, so the only learning needed is to put the food inside.

ideas.title: Hot-Air Warning Shell

new_nodes.label: Cool-touch outer skin
new_nodes.detail: A cool-to-touch outer layer keeps the outside safe to hold even during cooking.

ideas.rationale: An outside that stays cool means the user cannot be burnt by a mistaken touch.

ideas.title: Bell-Free Tone Chime

ideas.rationale: An end signal tuned to older ears is heard without any setting or adjustment.

ideas.title: Door Glow Heat Meter

ideas.rationale: The heat state is visible from across the room with no labels to read.

new_nodes.label: Single START tile

new_nodes.label: Weight-sensing turntable

ideas.title: Magnetic Click Heat Dial

new_nodes.label: Magnetic detent knob

ideas.title: Haptic Power Feedback

ideas.title: Magnetic Nudge Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic push-to-open latch
new_nodes.detail: A magnet holds the door and releases it with a light push.

ideas.rationale: Pushing the door itself replaces the lever mechanism, so no button or mechanism needs explaining.

ideas.title: Wave-to-Start

new_nodes.detail: An infrared sensor starts the cycle when the user waves a hand over the front panel.

ideas.rationale: A wave is a universal gesture, so there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Scent Done Signal

ideas.rationale: The smell tells the user it is done without any beep or number to interpret.

ideas.title: Haptic Tray Pulse

new_nodes.detail: The turntable vibrates gently to signal the end of cooking.

ideas.rationale: A physical nudge replaces the bell, so the signal works even for users who cannot hear well.

ideas.title: Ambient Done Glow

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit door glow

ideas.rationale: A single colour state gives status at a glance without any display to read.

ideas.title: Window Becomes Mirror

new_nodes.label: Electrochromic door glass
new_nodes.detail: The door window turns from opaque to clear when the oven is powered on.

ideas.rationale: The glass shows the cooking state, so the user does not need a separate lamp or indicator.

ideas.title: Lamp-Free Clear Cavity

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: A clear coating lets light from outside show the food without a bulb inside.

ideas.rationale: The food is visible with no lamp to switch on or explain.

ideas.title: Motorless Mode Stirrer

new_nodes.label: Rotating field stirrer
new_nodes.detail: A rotating metal vane inside the cavity spreads microwaves evenly without moving the food.

ideas.rationale: Without a turntable, the user has nothing to position and nothing to misplace.

ideas.title: Self-Centring Dish Well

new_nodes.label: Bowl-shaped self-centring tray
new_nodes.detail: A dished tray guides any plate to the centre and holds it steady.

ideas.rationale: The tray places food correctly by shape, so the user never has to think about placement.

ideas.title: USB-C Power Only

new_nodes.label: USB-C power delivery input
new_nodes.detail: The oven runs from a standard USB-C charger with a low-power heater element.

ideas.rationale: Users already know how to plug in a USB cable, so the power connection needs no learning.

ideas.title: Cordless Induction Puck

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF heating
new_nodes.detail: A solid-state amplifier replaces the magnetron and its high-voltage parts.

ideas.rationale: Removing the high-voltage parts removes the need for a cord warning or a discharge procedure.

ideas.title: Inductive Base Pad

new_nodes.label: Wireless base station
new_nodes.detail: The oven sits on a base that supplies power by induction, with no plug to insert.

ideas.rationale: Setting the oven on a pad is the only action required to connect power.

ideas.title: Solid-State HV Free

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage gallium nitride driver
new_nodes.detail: A low-voltage driver makes high-voltage storage unnecessary.

ideas.rationale: No stored lethal charge means the user never needs to wait or worry after unplugging.

ideas.title: Auto-Discharge Bleeder

new_nodes.label: Passive bleeder resistor
new_nodes.detail: A resistor drains the capacitor within seconds of switch-off.

ideas.rationale: The unit is safe to touch immediately, so no wait-and-check routine has to be learned.

ideas.title: Hall-Effect Door Sensor

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door sensor
new_nodes.detail: A single Hall-effect sensor confirms the door is shut and replaces three switches.

ideas.rationale: One sensor that either works or does not is far simpler for the user to trust and understand.

ideas.title: Snap Thermostat to Sensor

new_nodes.label: Infrared food thermometer
new_nodes.detail: A thermopile reads surface temperature and ends cooking at the right point.

ideas.rationale: Reading the food directly removes the need for the user to understand cooking times.

ideas.title: Steam-Sense Auto Stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity-based doneness sensing
new_nodes.detail: A humidity sensor detects steam output and stops when food is hot.

ideas.rationale: The oven ends cooking without a time to set, so nothing needs learning.

ideas.title: Sand Timer Tray

new_nodes.label: Physical sand-glass timer
new_nodes.detail: A sand-glass runs as the food cooks, and empty means done.

ideas.rationale: Watching sand fall is self-explanatory, so no digits or dials need interpretation.

ideas.title: Hourglass Heat Level

new_nodes.label: Slow-fill cooking by fill time
new_nodes.detail: The user chooses cook time by filling a clear chamber with water.

ideas.rationale: Filling a visible chamber replaces an abstract timer dial with a direct physical quantity.

ideas.title: Food Picture Dial

new_nodes.label: Photo menu dial
new_nodes.detail: A single rotating dial shows photos of common meals and starts the matching program.

ideas.rationale: Choosing a photo of the meal needs no knowledge of times or power levels.

ideas.title: Two-Icon Panel

new_nodes.label: Hot and cold icon panel
new_nodes.detail: The panel offers only a warm icon and a reheat icon, with no numbers.

ideas.rationale: Two icons are the simplest possible control layout.

ideas.title: Voice Phrases Only

new_nodes.label: Plain phrase recognition
new_nodes.detail: The oven responds to everyday phrases such as 'warm my soup'.

ideas.rationale: Speaking the request in ordinary words replaces any control or manual.

ideas.title: Chef-Less Auto Recipe

new_nodes.label: Automatic recipe matching
new_nodes.detail: The oven recognises the food type from the cavity camera and picks the program.

ideas.rationale: The machine chooses every setting, so the user only inserts the food.

ideas.title: Pressure Plate Start

new_nodes.label: Pressure-sensing floor pad
new_nodes.detail: A pad under the tray starts cooking when the food sits on it.

ideas.rationale: Placing food on the tray is the only action, with no buttons at all.

ideas.title: Flip-Up Lid Door

new_nodes.label: Top-hinged lid
new_nodes.detail: A lid lifts like a bread box and needs no latch or hook.

ideas.rationale: A lid that lifts with a finger has no mechanism to understand.

ideas.title: Gravity Hatch

new_nodes.label: Self-closing gravity hatch
new_nodes.detail: A heavy hatch closes by gravity and seals the cavity.

ideas.rationale: Closing happens on its own, so the user never has to check whether the door is sealed.

ideas.title: Liquid Metal Seal

new_nodes.label: Self-healing liquid metal gasket
new_nodes.detail: A gallium alloy seal reforms itself after damage and seals the gap.

ideas.rationale: A seal that repairs itself removes the need for any user maintenance.

ideas.title: Ceramic Self-Clean Cover

new_nodes.label: Glazed ceramic splatter cover
new_nodes.detail: A glazed ceramic cover resists sticking and wipes clean in one pass.

ideas.rationale: A surface that wipes clean with no scrubbing means no cleaning routine to learn.

ideas.title: Wipe-Clean Silicone Liner

new_nodes.label: Disposable microwave liner
new_nodes.detail: A printed liner sits on the floor and is replaced when dirty.

ideas.rationale: Replacing a liner is simpler than knowing how to clean the cavity.

ideas.title: Cloud Recipe Hub

new_nodes.label: Delivery service
new_nodes.detail: The delivery service sends the cooking program with the meal.

ideas.rationale: The meal provider sets the program, so the user never configures anything.

ideas.title: Pre-Heated Lunch Box

new_nodes.label: Heating lunch box
new_nodes.detail: A portable box heats its own food from a battery when the lid is closed.

ideas.rationale: Closing the lid starts heating, so there is no oven to operate.

ideas.title: Mug Microwave

new_nodes.label: Self-heating mug
new_nodes.detail: A mug heats its contents on a single press of its base.

ideas.rationale: A mug with one press needs no oven, door or dial.

ideas.title: Cup Seat Heating

new_nodes.label: Heated cup stand
new_nodes.detail: A stand that holds a cup and warms its contents when the cup is set down.

ideas.rationale: Placing the cup on the stand is the whole operation.

ideas.title: Door-Is-Power Switch

new_nodes.label: Close-to-start
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts cooking and opening it stops cooking.

ideas.rationale: Closing a door is an action everyone already knows, so no start button is needed.

ideas.title: Trusted Preset Only

new_nodes.label: One-touch preset memory
new_nodes.detail: The oven remembers the last meal and repeats it with one press.

ideas.rationale: Repeating the last successful meal removes choice and therefore confusion.

ideas.title: Feedback Chime Replaced

new_nodes.label: Sticky-note display
new_nodes.detail: A small paper-like screen shows a plain message like 'Done'.

ideas.rationale: A plain written word is understood instantly and does not depend on timing precision.

ideas.title: Hand Warmer Mode

new_nodes.label: Single warm setting
new_nodes.detail: The oven warms all food to a safe serving temperature with no other options.

ideas.rationale: A single outcome means the user can never choose wrongly.

ideas.title: Superheat-Proof Stir Stick

new_nodes.label: Built-in stirring rod
new_nodes.detail: A rod in the cavity stirs liquid automatically to prevent eruptive boiling.

ideas.rationale: Stirring is done by the machine, so the user does not need to know about superheating.

ideas.title: Metal-Safe Cavity

new_nodes.label: Foil-tolerant cavity coating
new_nodes.detail: The cavity tolerates metal and prevents arcing automatically.

ideas.rationale: The user does not need to learn which containers are safe.

ideas.title: Browning Tray Hint

new_nodes.label: Self-browning tray
new_nodes.detail: A tray with a crisping layer that browns food without any setting.

ideas.rationale: Browning happens with no extra settings, so the user gets crisp food without learning a function.

ideas.title: Stop Button Only Door

new_nodes.label: Single stop gesture
new_nodes.detail: A single large pad stops and opens the oven in one action.

ideas.rationale: One large pad with one meaning is the simplest possible stop control.

ideas.title: Cavity Sound Sealer

new_nodes.label: Silent operation housing
new_nodes.detail: A sealed housing removes the fan and magnetron hum so cooking is silent.

ideas.rationale: Silent operation removes the need to listen for a signal, so the user just checks the food.

ideas.title: Sleep-Off Auto Power

new_nodes.label: Auto power-down
new_nodes.detail: The oven shuts down fully when not in use and needs no switch.

ideas.rationale: No on or off switch exists to remember or misuse.

ideas.title: Bird-Shaped Door Handle

ideas.rationale: A handle that shows its own direction removes any need for instructions.

ideas.title: Simple Flat Switch Stove

new_nodes.detail: A flat rocker: up means heat, down means off.

new_nodes.label: Binary control
new_nodes.detail: On and off are the only states.

ideas.rationale: A rocker switch has two obvious states and nothing else to learn.

ideas.title: Glove-Proof Big Keys

new_nodes.label: Oversized key pad
new_nodes.detail: Large keys that work with oven gloves or wet hands.

new_nodes.label: Forgiving input

ideas.rationale: Big forgiving keys mean that mistakes are hard to make and easy to fix.

ideas.title: Ambient Light Done Glow

new_nodes.label: Quiet completion
new_nodes.detail: Signals completion without sound or words.

ideas.rationale: A gentle glow is understood at once and suits any room.

ideas.title: One-Word Screen

new_nodes.label: Single-word display
new_nodes.detail: A small screen that shows only one word at a time, such as 'Ready' or 'Heating'.

new_nodes.label: Minimal status
new_nodes.detail: Shows one clear status word.

ideas.rationale: One word at a time avoids the confusion of numbers and menus.

ideas.title: Egg-Timer Shell

new_nodes.label: Egg-shaped timer
new_nodes.detail: A dial shaped like an egg timer that turns to a heat level and ends with a spring stop.

new_nodes.label: Familiar timer
new_nodes.detail: Reuses the look of a classic kitchen timer.

ideas.rationale: People already know how a timer dial works, so the learning curve is zero.

ideas.title: Hand-Over-Plate Sense

new_nodes.label: Proximity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Starts heating when a hand is held over the plate, then stops when the hand is removed.

new_nodes.label: Hold-to-heat
new_nodes.detail: Heating happens only while the user holds a hand over it.

ideas.rationale: Holding a hand over food is a direct gesture that needs no explanation.

ideas.title: Kettle-Style Lid Click

new_nodes.label: Click-to-heat handle
new_nodes.detail: A handle that clicks down to heat, like a kettle, and springs up when done.

new_nodes.label: Spring-up done
new_nodes.detail: The handle pops up to signal the end.

ideas.rationale: A kettle-style handle is already understood by almost everyone.

ideas.title: Pre-Set Pantry Cards

new_nodes.label: Pantry card stack
new_nodes.detail: Printed cards for common foods, each with a picture and a single button to press.

new_nodes.label: Card-led cooking
new_nodes.detail: The card is placed on the machine to set the cook.

ideas.rationale: Placing a card that shows the food sets the machine with no reading or learning.

ideas.title: Door-Glass Touch Pictures

new_nodes.label: Touch-glass picture panel
new_nodes.detail: Door glass that accepts taps on pictures of food.

new_nodes.label: Tap-on-door control
new_nodes.detail: Controls live on the door itself.

ideas.rationale: Controls sit where the user is already looking, so no hunting is needed.

ideas.title: Ask-the-Food Reheat

new_nodes.label: Food-type scanner
new_nodes.detail: Camera that identifies the food type from its appearance.

new_nodes.label: Food recognition
new_nodes.detail: Recognises common foods from images.

ideas.rationale: The machine looks at the food and does the setting, so the user answers no questions.

ideas.title: Food-Pack NFC Auto-Program

new_nodes.label: NFC food-pack tag
new_nodes.detail: Passive tag on packaging carries power level and time, read by the oven on placement.

ideas.rationale: The user never sets a dial because the food package tells the oven what to do.

ideas.title: Tap-a-Picture Control Strip

new_nodes.label: Pictogram touch strip
new_nodes.detail: Single capacitive strip showing pictures of rice, soup, pizza, frozen, reheat.

ideas.rationale: Users recognise food pictures faster than they read numbers or dial positions.

ideas.title: Weigh-to-Cook Platter

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable
new_nodes.detail: Turntable sits on load cells that read food mass and set time automatically.

ideas.rationale: The oven decides how long to cook by weighing the plate, so no timer has to be set.

ideas.title: Steam-Sense Auto Stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor vent
new_nodes.detail: Vent sensor detects steam rise and ends heating when steam drops off.

ideas.rationale: Stopping when the food stops steaming means the user never guesses a time.

ideas.title: Induction Pad Power Base

new_nodes.label: Inductive power pad
new_nodes.detail: Oven sits on a flat pad that powers it through the base, so no plug is ever inserted.

ideas.rationale: Setting it down on the pad is the only action needed to power it on.

ideas.title: Drop-In Self-Powered Puck

new_nodes.label: Cooking puck battery
new_nodes.detail: Oven runs off a rechargeable pack that charges when the oven rests on its dock.

ideas.rationale: Carrying a self-contained unit around the kitchen removes the cable question entirely.

ideas.title: Solid-State GaN Amplifier

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Transistor-based RF source runs at low voltage, replacing the magnetron and HV chain.

ideas.rationale: Without lethal high voltage the user has no safety rules to remember and no discharge worry.

ideas.title: Ambient Done-Glow Cavity

new_nodes.label: Edge LED glow ring
new_nodes.detail: Ring of light around the cavity pulses slowly while cooking and turns green when done.

ideas.rationale: The light shows status without any reading, so nothing has to be interpreted.

ideas.title: Palm-Buzz Done Alert

new_nodes.label: Haptic coaster
new_nodes.detail: Small coaster the user carries buzzes when food finishes.

ideas.rationale: A buzz in your hand is a clearer signal than a bell heard from another room.

ideas.title: Silent Countertop Pulse

new_nodes.label: Tabletop light pulse
new_nodes.detail: Light pulses through the counter surface to indicate the end of cooking.

ideas.rationale: Silent, glanceable signalling works in shared flats where a bell annoys people.

ideas.title: Tray Icon Magnet Lock

new_nodes.label: Magnetic plate ID
new_nodes.detail: Each plate has a magnetic code that sets the oven when placed on the turntable.

ideas.rationale: Placing a plate is the only step and the plate decides the settings.

ideas.title: Fridge-Style Drawer Door

new_nodes.label: Sliding drawer front
new_nodes.detail: Door slides out sideways like a drawer, with no hinge or latch to find.

ideas.rationale: Anyone who can open a drawer can open this, with no hook or button to learn.

ideas.title: Wave-to-Open Door

new_nodes.label: Proximity door sensor
new_nodes.detail: Door opens automatically when a hand is held near the handle.

ideas.rationale: The door responds to the natural gesture of reaching for it, so no button is needed.

ideas.title: Bowl-Tap Start

new_nodes.label: Bowl contact sensor
new_nodes.detail: Oven starts once the bowl sits on the base and the lid is closed.

ideas.rationale: The act of putting food in is the start command, so no start button is needed.

ideas.title: Magnetic Breakaway Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door catch
new_nodes.detail: Strong magnetic catch that releases on a light push and cannot jam.

ideas.rationale: A magnet with no moving hooks fails less and is easier to operate than a spring lever.

ideas.title: Ceramic Foil-Safe Cavity

new_nodes.label: Ceramic cavity lining
new_nodes.detail: Glazed ceramic liner stops arcing from foil and sharp metal edges.

ideas.rationale: Users can put in any dish, including foil, without a rule to remember.

ideas.title: Glass-Bead Eruption Guard

new_nodes.label: Boil-safe bead tray
new_nodes.detail: Dish sits on a tray of small glass beads that prevent superheating.

ideas.rationale: Users can heat drinks without fearing a sudden eruption, so no warning is needed.

ideas.title: Auto-Reheat Only Mode

new_nodes.label: Single-setting reheat
new_nodes.detail: One automatic mode adjusts power and time for any food.

ideas.rationale: Removing all power choices means there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Hot-Plate Ring Feedback

new_nodes.label: Thermal indicator ring
new_nodes.detail: Ring on the outside of the cavity changes colour when the walls get hot.

ideas.rationale: A visible hot-warning replaces an invisible thermostat the user can't check.

ideas.title: Self-Regulating PTC Heater

new_nodes.label: PTC self-limiting element
new_nodes.detail: Ceramic element that limits its own temperature without a switch.

ideas.rationale: No thermostat means no trip-out to diagnose or reset.

ideas.title: Stackable Pictogram Trays

new_nodes.label: Stacking food tray
new_nodes.detail: Trays stack by picture, each carrying its own cooking profile.

ideas.rationale: Picking the tray for the food sets the cook, so users never think about settings.

ideas.title: Disposable Splash Film

new_nodes.label: Peel-off splash film
new_nodes.detail: Cheap disposable film covers the inside and peels off each week.

ideas.rationale: Replacing mica cleaning with peel-off film removes scrubbing from the user's routine.

ideas.title: Self-Cleaning Plasma Walls

new_nodes.label: Catalytic wall coating
new_nodes.detail: Walls coated to break down grease and splatter during cooking.

ideas.rationale: The oven cleans itself, so the user never needs a cleaning procedure.

ideas.title: Ambient-Light Interior Camera

new_nodes.label: Cavity camera module
new_nodes.detail: Small camera mounted in the ceiling streams the cavity to the door display.

ideas.rationale: Users see inside without needing a bulb or window, so they see food state at a glance.

ideas.title: Door Window Projection

new_nodes.label: Door display projector
new_nodes.detail: Projects a clear image of the food and timer onto the door glass.

ideas.rationale: Status appears on the door where the user looks, without a separate panel.

ideas.title: Electrochromic Door Glass

new_nodes.label: Electrochromic film
new_nodes.detail: Door glass goes frosted during cooking and clear when done.

ideas.rationale: The door shows completion by itself, without needing the user to look inside.

ideas.title: Turntable-Free Mode Stir

new_nodes.label: Stirring mode vane
new_nodes.detail: Fixed vane in the cavity moves microwave modes so food heats evenly with no turntable.

ideas.rationale: No rotating glass means nothing to take out, wash, or put back on the spindle.

ideas.title: Magnetic Gear Turntable

new_nodes.label: Magnetic drive hub
new_nodes.detail: Turntable is driven by a magnetic coupling so the plate lifts out and needs no spindle.

ideas.rationale: The plate drops in and out without alignment, so cleaning and loading take no thought.

ideas.title: Ceramic Floating Plate

new_nodes.label: Ceramic floating plate
new_nodes.detail: Ceramic plate floats on air jets and needs no glass or motor.

ideas.rationale: A plate that floats is one part with no drive mechanism to wear out.

ideas.title: Dishwasher Plate Set

new_nodes.label: Dishwasher-safe turntable
new_nodes.detail: Turntable made of unbreakable polymer that fits the dishwasher.

ideas.rationale: Cleaning is done by the dishwasher, so the user does not have to handle the plate.

ideas.title: Dial-Free Rotary Ring

new_nodes.label: Single rotary ring
new_nodes.detail: One ring turns for food category and a click confirms; no timer or power knob.

ideas.rationale: A single control with one action removes the need to understand several dials.

ideas.title: Voice-Free Shape Picker

new_nodes.label: Food shape camera
new_nodes.detail: Camera recognises the food and proposes one setting for confirmation.

ideas.rationale: The oven picks the program itself, so the user only presses one confirm.

ideas.title: Hand-Gesture Power Wave

new_nodes.label: Gesture sensor
new_nodes.detail: Sensor on the front detects a swipe to change power and a tap to start.

ideas.rationale: Swipes are learned from a phone, so the controls feel familiar at first touch.

ideas.title: Phone Cook Card

new_nodes.label: Phone tap cooking
new_nodes.detail: User taps phone to oven to send a full cooking program in one go.

ideas.rationale: The phone holds the instructions, so the oven needs no buttons at all.

ideas.title: Doorstop Power Switch

new_nodes.label: Door-closing power
new_nodes.detail: Power starts when the door closes and stops when it opens.

ideas.rationale: Closing the door is the only step, which people already do without thinking.

ideas.title: Cup-Shaped Microwave

new_nodes.label: Mug-shaped oven
new_nodes.detail: Mug-sized oven where the cup itself is the cavity and it heats when placed on the base.

ideas.rationale: A cup-sized appliance needs no timer or cavity decisions for one person's meal.

ideas.title: Shelf-Hung Oven

new_nodes.label: Under-cabinet microwave
new_nodes.detail: Oven mounted under a shelf that lowers to the counter when opened.

ideas.rationale: Mounting it out of the way means the student never has to decide where it lives.

ideas.title: Hot-Swap Cassette

new_nodes.label: Sealed magnetron cartridge
new_nodes.detail: Sealed RF cartridge that is swapped as a unit when it fails.

ideas.rationale: Users never open the casing, so fixing a fault is a cartridge swap, not a repair.

ideas.title: Auto-Discharge Passive Key

new_nodes.label: Passive bleed network
new_nodes.detail: Resistor network drains the capacitor within a second of switch-off.

ideas.rationale: The charge is gone before anyone can touch it, so no warning label is needed.

ideas.title: Self-Locking Cable Dock

new_nodes.label: Magnetic power connector
new_nodes.detail: Connector snaps into place magnetically and disconnects safely on a pull.

ideas.rationale: Plugging in cannot be done wrong, and pulling the cable cuts power instantly.

ideas.title: Pet-Safe Door Lock

new_nodes.label: Child-safe interlock cover
new_nodes.detail: Door stays shut while the oven is on, so no button is needed to stop it.

ideas.rationale: The door is safe by default, so there's no lock setting to learn.

ideas.title: Ring Timer Cordless Remote

new_nodes.label: Hand-held timer ring
new_nodes.detail: Ring worn on the finger counts down and taps when food is ready.

ideas.rationale: The ring is always on the user, so nothing is missed or misread.

ideas.title: Snap-Temperature Sticker

new_nodes.label: Colour-change food sticker
new_nodes.detail: Sticker on the plate turns colour when the food reaches safe temperature.

ideas.rationale: The plate tells the user when it is safe, so nothing needs reading on the oven.

ideas.title: Audio-Free Status Hum

new_nodes.label: Tonal status hum
new_nodes.detail: Oven hums a gentle tone that changes pitch as food nears done.

ideas.rationale: A rising hum shows progress without any screen or reading.

ideas.title: Bulb-Free Heat Sync

new_nodes.label: Heat-balanced cook
new_nodes.detail: Oven adjusts output to match the food's heat so the user never picks a power level.

ideas.rationale: A machine that sets its own power level removes the only choice the user had to make.

ideas.title: Ice-Cube Heat Control

new_nodes.label: Phase-change heat sink
new_nodes.detail: Wax pad absorbs excess heat so food never overcooks at any power level.

ideas.rationale: Overcooking is physically blocked, so the user cannot make a costly mistake.

ideas.title: Gravity Feed Door

new_nodes.label: Self-closing gravity door
new_nodes.detail: Door swings shut under spring tension after food is placed.

ideas.rationale: The door closes itself, so there is nothing to forget or fail to latch.

ideas.title: Ambient Scent Done Signal

new_nodes.label: Scent emitter
new_nodes.detail: Oven releases a faint food-like scent when cooking is complete.

ideas.rationale: A smell signal is noticed by people who are not looking at the oven.

ideas.title: Fold-Away Oven Chassis

new_nodes.label: Foldable shell
new_nodes.detail: Shell folds flat for storage and unfolds for use, moulded from one polymer piece.

ideas.rationale: A flat-packed oven that folds away suits a student's small room.

ideas.title: Single-Button Auto Cook

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor array
new_nodes.detail: Reads vapour from food and decides when cooking is done

new_nodes.label: Auto-selects time and power
new_nodes.detail: Removes the need for any user setting

ideas.rationale: One button and no settings means a first-time user cannot get it wrong.

ideas.title: Food Icon Drum Replaces Timer Knob

new_nodes.label: Pictogram drum
new_nodes.detail: Rotating drum showing food icons such as rice, pizza and soup

ideas.rationale: Users pick what they are cooking instead of guessing minutes.

ideas.title: Weight Plate Sets Everything

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable
new_nodes.detail: Turntable that weighs the food and sets power and time from mass

ideas.rationale: Placing food on the plate is the only step the user takes.

ideas.title: Touch-Anywhere Door

new_nodes.label: Capacitive door panel
new_nodes.detail: Large flat panel that opens the door when pressed anywhere

ideas.rationale: No button to hunt for, so opening the door is obvious.

ideas.title: Magnetic Self-Latching Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic detent latch
new_nodes.detail: Magnets hold the door closed and release it on a gentle push

ideas.rationale: Closing the door always works, with no need to press it hard or align hooks.

ideas.title: Drop-In Drawer Door

new_nodes.label: Sliding drawer front
new_nodes.detail: Door slides sideways like a drawer, with no swing clearance

ideas.rationale: A drawer motion is already known to everyone, so there is nothing new to learn.

ideas.title: Scent Chime

new_nodes.label: Scent cartridge release
new_nodes.detail: Releases a faint food smell when cooking finishes

new_nodes.label: Signals completion by smell
new_nodes.detail: Tells the user the food is ready without sound

ideas.rationale: The smell of finished food tells the user it is ready without any panel reading.

ideas.title: Haptic Door Pulse

new_nodes.label: Handle vibration motor
new_nodes.detail: Handle buzzes gently at the end of cooking

ideas.rationale: A buzz in the hand is clear even in a noisy kitchen or to someone with hearing loss.

ideas.title: Door Springs Open at Finish

new_nodes.label: Spring door opener
new_nodes.detail: Door pops open a few centimetres when cooking finishes

ideas.rationale: The physical state of the machine itself signals that the meal is done.

ideas.title: NFC Meal Tag Programming

new_nodes.label: NFC tag reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads a tag on the food packet and loads the cook program

ideas.rationale: The user taps the packet to the oven and the correct settings load themselves.

ideas.title: Packet Barcode Scan

new_nodes.label: Barcode window scanner
new_nodes.detail: Reads the packet barcode through the door window

ideas.rationale: Pressing start on a packet already set up for the oven needs no decisions.

ideas.title: Tap-to-Add Puck

new_nodes.label: Tap puck
new_nodes.detail: Each tap adds 10 seconds and the heat stops when the puck is removed

ideas.rationale: Counting taps is simpler than reading a dial and works for short durations.

ideas.title: Hold-to-Run Heat

new_nodes.label: Heat only while held
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while the user holds a button

ideas.rationale: The machine only heats while the user is paying attention, so no timer is needed.

ideas.title: Food Memory

new_nodes.label: Usage learning model
new_nodes.detail: Remembers the user's past choices and suggests them next time

ideas.rationale: The machine does the learning so the user never has to.

ideas.title: Heat-Map Glass Display

new_nodes.label: Printed heat-map film
new_nodes.detail: Film on the door window that changes colour as the food warms

ideas.rationale: Colour shows progress at a glance, with no timer to read.

ideas.title: Solid-State Inverter Replaces Diode Stack

new_nodes.label: GaN switching inverter
new_nodes.detail: Switching power supply that drives the magnetron without a high-voltage diode

ideas.rationale: Removing the high-voltage stack removes the parts that can hurt a novice in service and makes the machine lighter and quieter.

ideas.title: No Stored Charge Design

new_nodes.label: Zero stored high voltage
new_nodes.detail: Energy is never held in a capacitor, so nothing stays charged

ideas.rationale: Users never need to worry about a lethal charge after unplugging.

ideas.title: IR Food Thermometer Stops Cooking

new_nodes.label: Infrared surface sensor
new_nodes.detail: Reads food surface temperature without touching the food

ideas.rationale: The machine stops by itself when the food is hot, so no thermostat setting is needed.

ideas.title: Electronic Thermistor Array

new_nodes.label: NTC thermistor array
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state temperature sensors replace the snap disc

ideas.rationale: Electronic sensors are reliable and never need a reset or a thermal snap.

ideas.title: Built-In Stir Rod

new_nodes.label: Spring stir rod
new_nodes.detail: Small rod that stirs liquid when cooking starts to break up superheating

ideas.rationale: The machine prevents eruptions by itself so users never need to know about superheating.

ideas.title: Crisp Floor Susceptor

new_nodes.label: Ceramic susceptor plate
new_nodes.detail: Plate that heats up and crisps the underside of food

ideas.rationale: Food comes out browned with no setting to choose.

ideas.title: Metal Detection Ring

new_nodes.label: Metal sensing loop
new_nodes.detail: Detects metal in the cavity and blocks heating

ideas.rationale: The machine refuses to start with metal inside, so the user never has to guess what is safe.

ideas.title: Dual-Mode Turntable Replacement

new_nodes.label: Mode stirrer fan
new_nodes.detail: Rotating metal fan that spreads microwaves evenly across the cavity

ideas.rationale: Food heats evenly with no plate to place and no motor to check.

ideas.title: Fixed Plate Multi-Feed

new_nodes.label: Multi-port waveguide feed
new_nodes.detail: Several feed points spread energy evenly so the plate can stay still

ideas.rationale: A fixed plate is easier to clean and cannot jam.

ideas.title: Printed Placement Grid Tray

new_nodes.label: Icon placement tray
new_nodes.detail: Ceramic tray with printed zones showing where to put each food

ideas.rationale: The printed zones show where food goes, so no instructions are needed.

ideas.title: Dishwasher Silicone Tray

new_nodes.label: Flexible silicone tray
new_nodes.detail: Soft tray that is dishwasher safe and never cracks

ideas.rationale: The tray is hard to break and simple to clean.

ideas.title: Crumb-Tolerant Gel Seal

new_nodes.label: RF-absorbing gel seal
new_nodes.detail: Gel seal that stops leakage and wipes clean

ideas.rationale: A seal that wipes clean removes the need for any special cleaning routine.

ideas.title: Fold-Out Silicone Splash Cover

new_nodes.label: Silicone splash cover
new_nodes.detail: Flexible cover that keeps splatter off the waveguide and wipes clean

ideas.rationale: Splatter is contained with a cover that needs no thought.

ideas.title: Magnetic Snap-On Cord

new_nodes.label: Magnetic plug connector
new_nodes.detail: Plug snaps into the socket and cannot be inserted the wrong way

ideas.rationale: Plugging in is effortless and cannot be done wrong.

ideas.title: Retractable Cord Reel

new_nodes.label: Cord reel
new_nodes.detail: Built-in reel that stores the cord when not in use

ideas.rationale: Nothing to coil or tangle, so there is nothing to figure out.

ideas.title: Countertop Power Dock

new_nodes.label: Inductive power dock
new_nodes.detail: Charging pad that connects the microwave without a cord

ideas.rationale: Setting the oven on the dock is the only connection step.

ideas.title: Student Battery Low-Power Mode

new_nodes.label: Swappable battery pack
new_nodes.detail: Pack that powers a 300 W mode for dorm rooms

ideas.rationale: Students can use it with no mains setup and nothing to plan.

ideas.title: Single Scroll Wheel Panel

new_nodes.label: Scroll wheel with three icons
new_nodes.detail: One wheel with icons for hot, warm and defrost

ideas.rationale: One control with three icons is easier to read than two knobs and a dial.

ideas.title: Hot Plate Reveal Lamp

new_nodes.label: E-ink status label
new_nodes.detail: Low-power label showing the current state in words

ideas.rationale: A plain word such as Cooking or Done explains the state without a light or manual.

ideas.title: Ambient Glow Cavity Walls

new_nodes.label: Electroluminescent wall film
new_nodes.detail: Thin film on the cavity walls that glows softly when the cavity is in use

ideas.rationale: The whole cavity lights evenly, so the user sees inside without a bulb in the way.

ideas.title: Bulb-Free Clear Casing

new_nodes.label: Transparent cavity shell
new_nodes.detail: Fully transparent casing that lets light reach the cavity from outside

ideas.rationale: Users can see the food without a bulb to replace or a switch to find.

ideas.title: Pet-Like Chirp Completion

new_nodes.label: Recognisable completion chirp
new_nodes.detail: Short tone that varies with food type

ideas.rationale: A distinct tone for each food is memorable and needs no reading.

ideas.title: Printed Melody Signal

new_nodes.label: Piezo melody buzzer
new_nodes.detail: Small piezo buzzer that plays a short melody at the end

ideas.rationale: A melody is easier to remember than a bell and stands out in a busy kitchen.

ideas.title: Shell Cooking Companion Cup

new_nodes.label: Self-timing cup
new_nodes.detail: Cup that signals the microwave when liquid is at the right temperature

ideas.rationale: The container tells the machine what to do so the user does not have to.

ideas.title: Single-Piece Moulded Housing

new_nodes.label: Single-shot moulded shell
new_nodes.detail: One moulded piece replaces stamped sheet and many screws

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts make the machine easier to understand and to fix.

ideas.title: Snap-Fit Panel Assembly

new_nodes.label: Tool-free snap-fit assembly
new_nodes.detail: Panels snap together with no screws, enabling simple repair

ideas.rationale: Simple repairs keep the machine simple to live with.

ideas.title: Stove-Top Hob Hybrid

new_nodes.label: Induction hob base
new_nodes.detail: Hob that heats the bottom of the dish while the microwave heats food

ideas.rationale: One unit browns and cooks, so the user has one control to learn.

ideas.title: Shared Cook Recipe Card

new_nodes.label: Recipe card reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads a printed card with a food picture and loads the cook program

ideas.rationale: A printed card is faster and clearer than any manual.

ideas.title: Voice-Free Gesture Start

new_nodes.label: Gesture sensor
new_nodes.detail: Hand wave above the door starts and stops the cycle

ideas.rationale: A wave of the hand is the only action required.

ideas.title: Hands-Free Foot Pedal

new_nodes.label: Foot pedal
new_nodes.detail: Floor pedal that opens the door when pressed with a foot

ideas.rationale: When hands are full, the foot opens the door with no thought.

ideas.title: Sealed Door Auto-Lock Lights Only

new_nodes.label: Door-open lockout
new_nodes.detail: Heat cuts out whenever the door is open, with no interlock dial

ideas.rationale: Safety is automatic, so the user has nothing to check.

ideas.title: Compact Stackable Unit

new_nodes.label: Stacking frame
new_nodes.detail: Frame that lets the unit sit on top of a fridge or another appliance

ideas.rationale: A single space-saving placement needs no planning.

ideas.title: Automatic Reheat Reminder

new_nodes.label: Leftover reminder
new_nodes.detail: Reminds the user that a meal has been cooling and offers to reheat

ideas.rationale: A single-person household gets a prompt that removes the need to plan.

ideas.title: Stored Program Dial Only

new_nodes.label: Program presets
new_nodes.detail: Five fixed programs on one dial, each named by food type

ideas.rationale: Five named choices is simpler than a timer with unknown numbers.

ideas.title: Ambient Sound Cooking Tune

new_nodes.label: Cooking background sound
new_nodes.detail: Soft sound plays while the magnetron is working

ideas.rationale: A steady sound lets the user know the machine is working without a display.

ideas.title: Waterproof Splash-Proof Control Face

new_nodes.label: Sealed membrane panel
new_nodes.detail: Flat sealed panel that cleans with a wipe and cannot be damaged by steam

ideas.rationale: A panel that wipes clean with no crevices is always simple to use.

ideas.title: Food-Sensing Auto-Cook

new_nodes.label: Infrared food-state sensing
new_nodes.detail: Thermal and humidity sensors read when food reaches serving temperature and stop automatically.

new_nodes.label: Cook until done without setting time
new_nodes.detail: The user never chooses a duration; the machine decides when to stop.

new_edges.from: Cook until done without setting time

ideas.rationale: Removing the duration dial means there is no time to calculate, so anyone can operate it on first use.

ideas.title: Tray-Is-The-Controller

new_nodes.label: Load-cell food recognition
new_nodes.detail: Weight and shape of the placed dish identify the food and set power automatically.

ideas.rationale: Placing food on the tray is the only action, so there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Glass Door Becomes Touch Panel

new_nodes.label: Proximity-sensing door
new_nodes.detail: The door opens when a hand or plate approaches, with no button to find.

ideas.rationale: A door that opens by approach removes the need to find and press a release button.

ideas.title: Bioluminescent Cavity

new_nodes.label: Electroluminescent cavity wall
new_nodes.detail: A thin film on the inner wall glows softly, visible through the door with no bulb.

ideas.rationale: The light is part of the walls, so there is no bulb to replace and no switch to find.

ideas.title: Scent Alarm Instead of Bell

new_nodes.label: Scent cartridge signal
new_nodes.detail: A faint smell of the food, released at completion, signals that it is done.

new_nodes.label: Signal completion without sound
new_nodes.detail: The user knows the food is ready without having to watch or listen.

ideas.rationale: A smell is an intuitive, language-free cue that needs no explanation.

ideas.title: Turntable Replaced by Rolling Cradle

new_nodes.label: Self-centering rolling cradle
new_nodes.detail: A low ring of rollers keeps the dish rotating and centered without a glass plate.

ideas.rationale: A cradle that centers any dish automatically means users never need to check that the plate is seated.

ideas.title: Dish Name Printed on Dish

new_nodes.label: NFC-tagged packaging
new_nodes.detail: Ready meal packaging carries a tag that sets the cooking program when placed inside.

ideas.rationale: The food itself carries its instructions, so the user never has to program anything.

ideas.title: Single Big Start Pebble

new_nodes.label: One large tactile pebble
new_nodes.detail: A single raised, glowing pebble that starts cooking whenever it is pressed.

ideas.rationale: One obvious control removes every decision about which button to press.

ideas.title: Speak Your Dinner

new_nodes.label: Plain-speech voice control
new_nodes.detail: The user says 'warm soup' or 'defrost bread' and the machine does it.

ideas.rationale: Ordinary speech needs no menus or symbols, so there is nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Weight-Based Cooking

new_nodes.label: Cook by weight of food
new_nodes.detail: Placing 300 g of food sets the correct power and time automatically.

ideas.rationale: Weight is an obvious, measurable input that replaces abstract power levels.

ideas.title: Power Knob Replaced by Heat Slider on Door

new_nodes.label: Hot-to-warm color strip
new_nodes.detail: A simple color gradient on the door, where the user slides a finger to pick hot or warm.

ideas.rationale: Hot and warm are words everyone already understands, so no numbers are needed.

ideas.title: Microwave Shaped Like a Drawer

new_nodes.label: Pull-out drawer cavity
new_nodes.detail: The whole cooking chamber slides out like a drawer, so loading is at waist height.

ideas.rationale: A drawer is a familiar motion that needs no instruction.

ideas.title: Transparent Sealed Pod

new_nodes.label: Clear sealed cooking pod
new_nodes.detail: A fully transparent heating pod that shows the food from any angle.

ideas.rationale: Seeing food clearly from all sides removes the need to open the door to check.

ideas.title: Cook Button Is the Door Itself

new_nodes.label: Door-close auto-start
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door with food inside starts the program immediately.

ideas.rationale: Closing a door is already a habit, so the machine starts with no extra step.

ideas.title: Icon Dishes Instead of Keypad

new_nodes.label: Picture-plate selector
new_nodes.detail: Large photos of common dishes on a dial; the user taps the picture of their meal.

ideas.rationale: Recognizing a picture of the meal is faster than reading any label.

ideas.title: Projected Control on Counter

new_nodes.label: Counter-top light projection
new_nodes.detail: Simple projected icons appear on the countertop beside the machine.

ideas.rationale: The controls appear where the user already looks, avoiding a distant panel.

ideas.title: Steam Window Self-Clears

new_nodes.label: Heated anti-fog glass
new_nodes.detail: The door glass stays clear automatically so the food is always visible.

ideas.rationale: Clear viewing needs no user action, so the user never has to wipe the glass.

ideas.title: Phone Buzzes When Done

new_nodes.label: Wireless done-notification
new_nodes.detail: The user's watch or phone gets a gentle vibration when cooking finishes.

ideas.rationale: The alert reaches the user wherever they are, with no need to hear a bell.

ideas.title: Microwave With No Settings at All

new_nodes.label: Default-only cooking
new_nodes.detail: The machine has one smart program that adapts to any food placed inside.

ideas.rationale: With no settings to choose, there is no possibility of confusion.

ideas.title: Magnetic Latch Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic self-latching door
new_nodes.detail: A magnetic seal closes and opens with a light push, with no mechanical latch.

ideas.rationale: A light push or pull is intuitive and requires no button.

ideas.title: Self-Cleaning Walls Remove Cleaning Manual

new_nodes.label: Catalytic self-cleaning coating
new_nodes.detail: The cavity coating breaks down spills during normal cooking.

ideas.rationale: Users never have to learn cleaning routines because the cavity cleans itself.

ideas.title: Plate-Sized Button Field

new_nodes.label: Full-width touch strip
new_nodes.detail: A wide strip along the front where any tap starts or stops cooking.

ideas.rationale: A large target that accepts any tap means the user cannot press the wrong button.

ideas.title: Robot Arm Loads Food

new_nodes.label: Built-in loading arm
new_nodes.detail: A small arm places the dish in the cavity when the user presses the tray.

ideas.rationale: The user only has to deliver the food to the machine, not load the cavity.

ideas.title: Microwave Reads the Label

new_nodes.label: Camera label recognition
new_nodes.detail: A camera reads the printed name or barcode on the food package.

ideas.rationale: The user shows the package, and the machine handles the rest.

ideas.title: Dial Replaced by Sliding Hand Gesture

new_nodes.label: Air-swipe gesture control
new_nodes.detail: A wave of the hand left or right adjusts the cooking level.

ideas.rationale: A wave is a universal gesture that needs no labels or instructions.

ideas.title: Auto-Lock Child Safety Removed

new_nodes.label: Inherently safe operation
new_nodes.detail: The microwave cannot run unless a correctly sized dish is present, so no lock is needed.

ideas.rationale: No lock to find or learn means safety works without the user knowing it exists.

ideas.title: Heat Is Shown as Color

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic food indicator
new_nodes.detail: A heat-reactive patch on the door changes color as the food heats.

ideas.rationale: Color progress is understood at a glance, with no reading or timing required.

ideas.title: Lid Acts as the Plate

new_nodes.label: Dish-as-cavity-floor
new_nodes.detail: The microwave uses whatever dish the user places on it, with no separate tray.

ideas.rationale: Using the user's own dish removes a part that could be lost, misplaced, or misunderstood.

ideas.title: Clock Face Becomes Progress Ring

new_nodes.label: Circular progress ring
new_nodes.detail: A ring of light fills up as cooking progresses, showing how close the food is to done.

ideas.rationale: A filling ring is a self-explanatory display that needs no number reading.

ideas.title: Solid-State Quiet Cooking

new_nodes.label: Solid-state RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the magnetron with a quiet, instant-on amplifier that is silent when idle.

ideas.rationale: A silent, instant-on machine has no warm-up or cooling noise to puzzle the user.

ideas.title: Stick-On Recipe Cards

new_nodes.label: Magnetic food cards
new_nodes.detail: Cards placed on the microwave door select the program when touched to the panel.

ideas.rationale: Physical cards mean the user only needs to pick a picture, not understand any function.

ideas.title: Oven Door Opens to Show Food

new_nodes.label: Full-glass swing door
new_nodes.detail: A door that is almost entirely glass with an automatic open on approach.

ideas.rationale: A clear door that opens on approach makes both viewing and access immediate.

ideas.title: Wireless Power Surface

new_nodes.label: Resonant wireless power
new_nodes.detail: The microwave sits anywhere on a power mat, so there is no cable to plug in.

ideas.rationale: No plug to find or insert removes an entire setup step.

ideas.title: Microwave That Holds Its Own Recipes

new_nodes.label: Remember the household's routines
new_nodes.detail: The machine learns what the user cooks most and offers it first.

ideas.rationale: The most common choice is always already selected, so the user does nothing.

ideas.title: Single Dial With Three Words

new_nodes.label: Three-word dial
new_nodes.detail: One dial with the words Reheat, Cook, Defrost in large letters.

ideas.rationale: Three plain verbs cover almost every need with no numbers to interpret.

ideas.title: Heat Pad Replaces Keypad

new_nodes.label: Pressure-sensing top pad
new_nodes.detail: Pressing the top of the microwave with a hand starts heating.

ideas.rationale: A large, natural press on the top surface is easier than finding a small button.

ideas.title: Food Tells the Microwave

new_nodes.label: Smell-based food detection
new_nodes.detail: A gas sensor identifies the food type from its aroma and sets the program.

ideas.rationale: The machine works out what to do from the food, so the user never has to decide.

ideas.title: Door Cannot Be Opened Wrongly

new_nodes.label: Automatic pause on opening
new_nodes.detail: Opening the door pauses cooking and resumes when closed, with no stop button.

ideas.rationale: Users can open the door at any time without needing to know how to stop cooking.

ideas.title: Microwave in a Tray Cover

new_nodes.label: Lidded serving bowl
new_nodes.detail: The bowl the food comes in is the only cooking vessel and fits the cavity.

ideas.rationale: Cooking and serving in one vessel removes the need to transfer food or choose containers.

ideas.title: Light Turns On at Your Gesture

new_nodes.label: Motion-activated glow
new_nodes.detail: The cavity glows only when someone approaches, so there is no switch.

ideas.rationale: The light appears automatically whenever it is needed, so nothing must be switched.

ideas.title: Microwave Speaks Your Language Via Icons

new_nodes.label: Universal pictogram display
new_nodes.detail: Icons only, with no text, that are understood by any user worldwide.

ideas.rationale: Pictograms need no reading skill or translation, so anyone can operate it.

ideas.title: Power Cord Replaced by Charging Stand

new_nodes.label: Dock-and-go base
new_nodes.detail: The microwave lifts off a wall-mounted dock that handles all power and cleaning.

ideas.rationale: A dock that simply holds the machine avoids all plug and cable decisions.

ideas.title: Microwave Explains Itself After Each Use

new_nodes.label: Post-cook one-line summary
new_nodes.detail: A short line shows what was cooked and how long, reinforcing learning without manuals.

ideas.rationale: Clear feedback after each use builds confidence without any instruction.

ideas.title: Tap the Plate to Reheat

new_nodes.label: Tap-to-start plate tag
new_nodes.detail: Tapping the plate's rim on the microwave triggers the stored reheat program.

ideas.rationale: Tapping an object the user already holds is the simplest possible gesture.

ideas.title: Transparent Lid Lifts to Load

new_nodes.label: Top-lift dome
new_nodes.detail: The whole top lifts like a lid on a pot, exposing the cavity in one motion.

ideas.rationale: Lifting a lid is already a learned motion that everyone performs with pots.

ideas.title: Microwave Stops When You Leave

new_nodes.label: Presence-aware cooking
new_nodes.detail: Cooking pauses if no one is nearby and resumes when someone returns.

ideas.rationale: Safe operation requires no timing decisions, because the machine tracks the user.

ideas.title: Snap-Fit Accessories Only

new_nodes.label: Single-fit accessory system
new_nodes.detail: Every accessory snaps in only one way, so wrong placement is impossible.

ideas.rationale: Mistakes are physically prevented, so there is nothing to learn about correct setup.

ideas.title: Cooking Happens Behind Frosted Glass

new_nodes.label: Smart-glass viewing
new_nodes.detail: The door is opaque while cooking and clear with a tap, removing the need for a light.

ideas.rationale: The door state itself shows what is happening, so no separate indicator is needed.

ideas.title: Microwave Chooses Its Own Power Level

new_nodes.label: Auto power by food density
new_nodes.detail: The machine detects how dense the food is and sets power with no user input.

ideas.rationale: Power is chosen for the user, so the knob's meaning never needs explaining.

ideas.title: Stickers Show Where Food Goes

new_nodes.label: Floor pattern guide
new_nodes.detail: A printed circle on the cavity floor shows exactly where to center the dish.

ideas.rationale: Visual placement guides help any user center food correctly on the first try.

ideas.title: Microwave in the Cupboard Door

new_nodes.label: Flush cabinet insert
new_nodes.detail: The microwave slides into a cabinet and opens like a cupboard door.

ideas.rationale: A cupboard door is a motion everyone already knows, so the appliance feels familiar.

ideas.title: Ding Replaced by Finished Tray Slide

new_nodes.label: Self-presenting tray
new_nodes.detail: When cooking ends the tray slides partway out to offer the finished dish.

ideas.rationale: The finished food is physically offered to the user, so no alarm needs to be understood.

ideas.title: One Button Means Everything

new_nodes.label: Universal single button
new_nodes.detail: A single button that opens, starts, and stops depending on the context.

ideas.rationale: One button with context-based meaning has nothing to memorize beyond pressing it.

ideas.title: Microwave Built From Food Packaging

new_nodes.label: Disposable heating sleeve
new_nodes.detail: A cheap sleeve around the food that generates the heating pattern itself.

ideas.rationale: The packaging does the work, so the user just places the food and presses start.

ideas.title: Pictogram Dial

new_nodes.label: Food pictogram dial
new_nodes.detail: Single rotary dial with large icons (popcorn, leftovers, frozen veg, drink) that sets time and power together.

ideas.rationale: Replacing the timer and power knobs with one icon dial removes the need to understand time and power levels.

ideas.title: Close-to-Start Door

new_nodes.label: Starts cooking on door close
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door with food inside begins a default heating cycle.

ideas.rationale: Closing the door is already a habit, so making it the start command removes the start button entirely.

ideas.title: Steam-Sensing Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity and VOC gas sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam and aroma release to judge when food is hot and stops heating.

ideas.rationale: The user never sets a time because the oven stops when the food smells and steams ready.

ideas.title: Thermal-Camera Doneness

new_nodes.label: Low-res thermal imaging
new_nodes.detail: Cheap thermopile array reads the surface temperature of food to decide when it is done.

ideas.rationale: The machine reads the food directly, so the user never has to guess power or time.

ideas.title: Transparent Cavity Without Lamp

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit conductive glass
new_nodes.detail: Glass with a transparent conductive coating lets light in while blocking microwaves.

ideas.rationale: A glowing transparent wall lets users check the food without any bulb or extra control.

ideas.title: Floor-Weighed Auto-Cook

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable base
new_nodes.detail: Turntable sits on a load cell that reads food weight and sets time automatically.

ideas.rationale: Weight alone tells the machine the right settings, so the user just places the food and presses nothing.

ideas.title: Gesture-Free Lean Open

new_nodes.label: Pressure-sensitive door skin
new_nodes.detail: A soft touch panel opens the door when pressed anywhere along its face.

ideas.rationale: Opening the door by pressing anywhere on it removes the search for a small release button.

ideas.title: Magnetic Snap Latch

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door latch
new_nodes.detail: Neodymium magnets hold the door shut and release it with a light tug.

ideas.rationale: A magnet closes and opens the door in one motion, so there is no latch mechanism to understand.

ideas.title: Sliding Drawer Oven

new_nodes.label: Sliding drawer cavity
new_nodes.detail: Cavity slides out like a drawer, so food is loaded from the front without a hinge.

ideas.rationale: A drawer is already understood by everyone, so loading the oven needs no instruction.

ideas.title: Hinge-Free Lift Lid

new_nodes.label: Gas-spring lift lid
new_nodes.detail: Top lid lifts on a gas spring like a bread bin and rests open on its own.

ideas.rationale: A lid that lifts and stays up needs no latch or button, so the oven works like a box.

ideas.title: Fog-Proof Seal Without Choke

new_nodes.label: Ceramic fiber gasket
new_nodes.detail: Compressed ceramic fiber seals the door without needing a quarter-wave choke.

ideas.rationale: A simpler seal removes the need for users to avoid bumping or misaligning the door.

ideas.title: Solid-State Replaces HV Doubler

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Gallium nitride amplifier produces the microwave power without high-voltage capacitors.

ideas.rationale: Removing the high-voltage stage removes the lethal charge hazard so the machine needs no warning cues.

ideas.title: Automatic Discharge Hook

new_nodes.label: Spring grounding hook
new_nodes.detail: Opening the door pulls a hook that shorts the high-voltage node to ground.

ideas.rationale: Discharge happens automatically when the door opens, so no one has to wait or worry.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Package Sensing

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic food label
new_nodes.detail: Label on the food turns colour when the food reaches safe serving temperature.
